## Summary

**The Lab runs entirely over the boundary.** Groups M
(`measurement.emit_metric`, `kernel.bundle`,
`kernel.check_completeness`, `kernel.reproduce`, `kernel.import`) and
L (`lab.serve`, plus the `lab.registry.*`/`lab.analysis.*` dispatch)
are implemented in `hh-embed` (`bundle_ops.rs`) and exercised over
*both* bindings — the in-process `EmbedService` and a spawned
`hh-kernel serve` child running newline JSON-RPC. The CLI's Lab nouns
(`definition`, `registry`, `experiment`, `results`, `compare`,
`bundle *`, `run export/import`, `lab serve`) forward op-for-op
through `Boundary::call`; there is no CLI-local kernel semantics.
`--dry-run` lowers onto the planning op, so parity with apply's
planning half is definitional. Pending Group L ops answer a typed
`stage_pending` refusal — the CLI surfaces it verbatim and never
fabricates a result.

**Bundles carry the contract.** `hh-bundle` implements `hh-bundle/1`:
manifest assembly with `instrument.component_versions` carrying the
kernel's `ContractIdentity`, `idp/1` `version_id` over the canonical
preimage, content-addressed member bytes (the `blob` domain), the
`LedgerExport` tree with `ledger_page:`/`ledger_tree:` members, the
directory and `HHB1` container codecs (byte-deterministic both ways),
the staged `validate_bundle` pass (S1–S7 + the S8 secret scan), the
R0–R3 level-derivation basis, and the import lift — foreign content
is recorded under `unverified` authority as references, never as
kernel-asserted facts. `kernel.bundle` supports `kind = "run"`; other
kinds answer `kind_pending` (ADR-0275 R-BUNDLE-1). A compile that
cannot run degrades the bundle to R0 with the typed `compile_error`
in the result rather than sinking the export.

**The fixture MCP server serves a bundle, nothing else.**
`hh-mcp-serve --bundle <dir> | --container <hhb1>` extracts the
`target:mcp` member, lowers `hh-mcp-target/1` into a deterministic
`hh-mcp-artifact/1`, and serves `initialize` / `server/discover` /
`tools/list` / `tools/call` / `ping` over newline JSON-RPC on stdio
(diagnostics only on stderr). The caller binding is `stdio_launch`
with `principal:test`; forged caller `_meta` changes nothing
(byte-identical responses); `HandleId`s never cross the wire; missing
grants, expired handles and pending stages are typed `isError`
refusals. `lab.serve` on the boundary performs the same lowering and
returns `{artifact, binding, launch}` — the kernel never holds a
socket for a fixture.
